extension.description: VeroScript editing, language intelligence, tasks and VM debugging using an external Runtime.
setting.stdlibSearchPaths: Standard-library directories. Empty uses the selected Runtime standard library.
setting.importPaths: Additional import directories, relative to the owning workspace folder.
setting.implicitImportPaths: Files imported implicitly, relative to the owning workspace folder.
setting.bindingCatalogPaths: Binding catalog files for metadata and stub bindings; these do not load native host implementations.
setting.predefinedMacros: Predefined macros: name, parameters, variadic and body.
setting.runtimePath: Runtime root containing veroscript, veroscript-lsp, veroscript-dap, stdlib and localization. Empty searches PATH.
setting.lsp.enabled: Enable language intelligence for this resource.
setting.lsp.executablePath: Path to a custom stdio language server. Leave empty to use the Runtime server.
setting.lsp.arguments: Arguments for the configured language server. Each array item is passed literally as one argument.
setting.maxWorkspaceFileBytes: Maximum bytes per indexed workspace file.
setting.lspTraceAnalysis: Log language-server analysis timings to VeroScript output.
setting.env: Process environment overrides. Use path settings instead of VERO_PATH or VERO_STDLIB_PATH.
setting.backend: Execution policy: mixed uses the VM without a selected JIT module; jit requires an explicit module. Debugging always uses the VM.
setting.jitBackendPath: Explicit JIT library file or directory for Run. Empty selects no module; mixed uses the VM. Relative paths use the owning workspace/source directory. Tasks inherit this value; an empty task value clears it. Check and debugging do not load this module.
setting.args: Script arguments, each passed as one argument.
setting.cwd: Working directory. Empty uses the owning workspace folder, or the source directory without a workspace.
task.action: Run the program or check it without execution.
debug.program: Saved .vs entry file. Relative paths use cwd, or the owning workspace folder.
debug.input: Initial script standard input. The Debug Console evaluates expressions; it is not an interactive input terminal.
debug.stopOnEntry: Stop at the program entry point.
debug.maxCallDepth: VM call-depth limit (0 uses the Runtime default).
debug.port: Port of an already listening TCP DAP host. Use attachMode domain to connect without loading a program.
debug.host: TCP DAP host address. Source paths must be valid on the host.
debug.attach.label: VeroScript: Attach to Host
debug.attach.program: Saved .vs entry file to load as a new script session in the host. It must exist at the same absolute path on both sides; relative paths use the owning workspace or source directory.
debug.domain.label: VeroScript: Attach to Domain
debug.attachMode: program loads a saved script in the host (default). domain connects to a host-prepared persistent domain and accepts no program or execution overrides; the host must advertise domain attachment support.
debug.domainId: Expected host domain ID. Only valid in domain mode. Empty or omitted uses the domain supplied by this endpoint.
setting.bracesOnNewLine: Move an empty declaration or control block opening brace to its own line when pressing Enter. Uses editor indentation and works without a Runtime.
